# About this list

This is the **full, layer-level list** of every record in the EcoCommons production catalogue — all **58,424** of them. Use the search box to filter across every column, and click a column header to sort.

The table below loads from [`ecocommons_datasets_full.csv`](data/ecocommons_datasets_full.csv) (also available to [download](data/ecocommons_datasets_full.csv)) — the complete export with **all 34 fields** per record, including `uuid`, usage counts (`event_view`, `event_download`, …), GCM/scenario, licence, source URL and more. Scroll the table horizontally to see every column.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("data/ecocommons_datasets_full.csv").csv({ typed: true })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof query = Inputs.search(data, {
  placeholder: "Search across all fields…",
  width: "100%"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
md`**${query.length.toLocaleString()}** of **${data.length.toLocaleString()}** records shown.`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(query, {
  rows: 18,
  sort: "title"
})
```
